purpose: Media presented inside a device or browser frame, with an optional caption.
accessibility: The footage is the picture: muted (source audio is task 044), its alt text kept in the IR and not drawn. It is clipped to the frame's screen under the theme scrim; the frame uses theme colours only. The caption uses the muted text token (WCAG AA) in its own band under the frame. A caption over two lines runs into the bottom margin.
